remarks: Welcome home to this charming Mesa Del Mar property! Offering over 2,000 square feet of living space, including 276 square feet of unpermitted space built by a general contractor, this home presents a wonderful opportunity to make it your own and create a space that fits your vision. Situated on an almost 7,000-square-foot lot, the property has been lovingly cared for by its original owner and features dual-pane windows and air conditioning. Bring your ideas and unlock the potential of this home in in this great neighborhood. Come enjoy the Mesa Del Mar lifestyle!
